game_title: Name Tag Match – Royal Stables Trial
game_concept: A logic puzzle set in The Kingdom – Royal Stables, the royal stables: the royal scribe must handle goblin raiders while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Name Tag Match: Match floating variable name tags to the values on passing grain sacks before they reach goblin raiders.
theme: The Kingdom – Royal Stables: the royal stables
core_gameplay_loop: In Royal Stables, repeat each round: Match floating variable name tags to the values on passing grain sacks before they reach goblin raiders. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the tag_matches value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the royal seal using at most 18 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: The royal seal reached with actions_used <= 18.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 18 before the royal seal is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 1 (intro tier): Name Tag Match
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Name Tag Match' (Week 1 slot 5), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Royal Stables'.
